versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the fundraising-faq skill.
- Generates tough, themed investor Q&A with strong, honest founder answers.
- Requires company description, stage, raise target, known weak spots, and key traction/team facts.
- Output groups tough questions by theme, gives strong model answers and traps to avoid.
- Includes guidance on handling weak spots, the scariest questions, and common red flags.
- Designed to help founders anticipate and confidently address due-diligence and pushback during fundraising.
